current.text: He is Minnesota's backup center behind Rudy Gobert.
Minnesota's big man depth is very thin. The only bigs are Gobert, Beringer, Lyles, Freeman and Rocco Zikarsky.
He should get about 10 to 11 more minutes a night than last season, for about 18 minutes as Gobert's main backup. That projection was trimmed after the Kuminga signing.
He is not expected to play power forward next to Gobert early in the season. One expert says that could change later in the year.
He has no real path to starting. His fantasy value depends on a Gobert injury. He would start and be a must-roster player if Gobert misses games.
In reserve minutes he is a low-end blocks and FG% player. He can probably average about 1.1 blocks.
In 28 minutes he could put up 12 points and 10 rebounds with 2.4 blocks on 60% shooting.
One expert says he may not be ready for the backup center role.
Drafting him in round 11 of 12-team standard leagues is too early. Draft him only as a stash in best ball, weekly, games cap or deep bench formats.
With the season ending March 28, Minnesota plays 4, 2 and 4 games in the fantasy playoffs, so week 20 is a two-game semifinal week. The team has the league minimum of 13 back-to-backs.

durable.text: He is a great shot blocker and a strong, instinctive offensive rebounder. His defensive rebounding technique is behind.
He does not stretch the floor and makes almost no threes. He shoots free throws around 70%.
His category profile is thin outside FG% and blocks. He is poor in steals, assists and threes, and subpar at the line.
Foul trouble is a concern for him.
Experts see him as a future NBA starter. They expect at least one top 50 fantasy season in his career.

With 6.4 points, 4.4 rebounds and 1.0 block projected, he has little value as a backup, so do not spend a roster spot on him at the auction. Watch Gobert's health early in the season and be ready to bid FAB if Gobert misses time, because the experts project 12 and 10 with 2.4 blocks on 60% shooting in starter minutes. Keep in mind Minnesota's two-game week 20.
